description: Compare one measured feature against a manufacturing process's limits and report whether it is within, marginal, or beyond them. Some limits are expressed as a ratio of material thickness rather than an absolute size — a 1 mm hole is fine in thin sheet and difficult in thick plate — so supply the thickness when the limit needs it. A result inside the limits is not a promise that a shop can make the part, or an estimate of what it costs. Pair this with a measured wall or hole size from a CAD server to answer whether a part suits a process.

measured.description: The measured value for the feature, in millimetres (or degrees for draft).

process.description: Which process the feature is being made by.

thickness.description: Material thickness in millimetres. Required when the limit is expressed as a ratio of thickness, which is common for sheet metal — the error says so if it is missing.

name: process_feasibility
title: Check a Feature Against Process Limits
